original: Before we start, are you happy for me to record this meeting so I can write Iowan's care plan? The recording is deleted once the plan is done. Yes, that's fine. Great. So Iowan's date of birth. 14th of March, 2017. He's nine. And what does he love doing? He loves trains, he can watch train videos for hours. And swimming, he's very calm in water. Anything we should watch out for. Crowds. When there are lots of people and noise, he covers his ears and starts rocking. Then he needs a quiet corner. How does he communicate? He has a few words. Choo-choo means he wants the train. If he says finish, he wants to stop whatever he is doing. At home with his grandmother he understands Bengali too. And mobility. He walks fine, but he runs off if he sees a train. You have to hold his hand near roads. Toilet. Toilet. He's toilet trained but needs reminding and help with wiping. Food and allergies. He's allergic to eggs, he gets a rash. And he only eats halal. Any behaviors that can be challenging. If he's upset he sometimes hits his head on the wall. We give him his headphones and his train book and he calms down. Thank you, that's really helpful.
